reran: cmd.sh on w3-int, w3-base and 2.13.18: joint order fails with 'identifier expected but `,` found' for both files; separate order prints 1. 2.12.20 rejects them too. Scala 3.7.4 joint also reports an error at the comma in both files.
user_impact: Nobody writing Java by hand. `enum E { , }` and `enum E { ,; ... }` are legal (JLS 8.9.1: EnumBody is { [EnumConstantList] [,] [EnumBodyDeclarations] }) and javac accepts them, but only a code generator that always emits a separator would produce one.
fixability: clear cut: in JavaParsers.enumDecl accept a comma before the first constant when `;` or `}` follows. No compatibility cost.
links: J4 to J9 are other wrong rejections by the same parser with different causes. No scala/bug ticket found (query: java enum trailing comma parser).
note: Cause confirmed by reading parseEnumConsts (JavaParsers.scala:1136-1147): a constant is parsed whenever the body does not start with `}`, `;` or end of file, and the comma is only looked for after a constant. Scala 3 has the same gap, so the two compilers agree with each other and disagree with javac.
